description:
Job Family : 
Software Development & Support 
 Travel Required : 
Up to 10% 
 Clearance Required : 
Ability to Obtain Public Trust 
 
 What You Will Do : 
 Build, test, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable full-stack enterprise software within Guidehouse’s Chief Transformation Officer (CXO) organization, supporting AI Transformation, Solution Studio, and other strategic CXO initiatives. This hands-on engineering role uses AI coding assistants and agents throughout software development, with human review and verification, and incorporates generative AI capabilities where they add value. Collaborating with Technical Product Managers and architects, you will deliver reliable, maintainable applications that meet business and technical requirements.
 Build, test, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable full-stack enterprise applications; deliver production-scale solutions or prototypes and MVPs as the assignment requires.
 Build end-to-end applications, including usable front-end experiences, backend services and APIs, data persistence, enterprise integrations, and authentication and authorization.
 Use AI coding assistants and agents for implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, and documentation; review and validate generated code and outputs for correctness, security, and maintainability.
 Engineer for performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability; validate behavior through automated tests, code reviews, and representative workloads.
 Integrate generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents, and tool calling when fit for purpose; evaluate solution quality, latency, cost, and security before scaling.
 Collaborate with Technical Product Managers and architects to clarify requirements, estimate engineering work, and communicate technical tradeoffs, dependencies, and delivery risks.
 Deploy and operate cloud-native solutions using automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability; implement enterprise security, privacy, and responsible AI controls.
 Monitor and troubleshoot deployed solutions; maintain technical documentation and support runbooks, and coordinate production readiness and handoff with IT and business owners.
 
 What You Will Need : 
 Bachelor’s degree; Four (4) years additional professional experience may be substituted in lieu of degree. 
 Minimum four (4) years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated independent delivery of production full-stack applications and experience deploying or operating cloud-native services.
 Hands-on proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern front-end framework, plus Python or another backend language; experience with APIs, databases, authentication, and enterprise integrations.
 Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents, with the ability to give clear instructions, critically review generated code, and validate behavior through tests and debugging.
 Minimum one (1) year of hands-on experience integrating generative AI or agent capabilities into applications, including an understanding of their limitations and evaluation needs.
 Experience with a major cloud platform, Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure as code; ability to troubleshoot using logs, metrics, and traces.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills: explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical audiences, demonstrate working solutions, ask clarifying questions, communicate progress and risks clearly, and engage professionally and credibly in stakeholder and client discussions.
 
 What Would Be Nice To Have : 
 Experience in client-facing solution engineering or consulting, or in enterprise transformation within a matrixed organization.
 Familiarity with workflows and regulatory requirements in Guidehouse industries: Healthcare; Financial Services; Communities, Energy & Infrastructure; and Defense & Security.
 Experience delivering production-scale solutions with demanding performance or reliability requirements, or developing reusable components and AI-assisted delivery practices.
 Relevant cloud, DevOps, or AI certifications.
 Master’s degree in relevant technical or business discipline.
 
 
The annual salary range for this position is $98,000.00-$163,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. 
 What We Offer : 
 Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.
 
 Benefits include:
 Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance

 Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

 Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus

 Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance

 401(k) Retirement Plan

 Basic Life & Supplemental Life

 Health Savings Account, Dental/Vision & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Student Loan PayDown

 Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development & Learning Opportunities

 Skills Development & Certifications

 Employee Referral Program

 Corporate Sponsored Events & Community Outreach

 Emergency Back-Up Childcare Program

 Mobility Stipend

 
 About Guidehouse 
 Guidehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer–Protected Veterans, Individuals with Disabilities or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.
 
 Guidehouse will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable law or ordinance including the Fair Chance Ordinance of Los Angeles and San Francisco.
 
 If you have visited our website for information about employment opportunities, or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Guidehouse Recruiting at 1-571-633-1711 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@guidehouse.com . All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodation.
 
 All communication regarding recruitment for a Guidehouse position will be sent from Guidehouse email domains including @guidehouse.com or guidehouse@myworkday.com .  Correspondence received by an applicant from any other domain should be considered unauthorized and will not be honored by Guidehouse.  Note that Guidehouse will never charge a fee or require a money transfer at any stage of the recruitment process and does not collect fees from educational institutions for participation in a recruitment event. Never provide your banking information to a third party purporting to need that information to proceed in the hiring process.
 
 If any person or organization demands money related to a job opportunity with Guidehouse, please report the matter to Guidehouse’s Ethics Hotline. If you want to check the validity of correspondence you have received, please contact recruiting@guidehouse.com . Guidehouse is not responsible for losses incurred (monetary or otherwise) from an applicant’s dealings with unauthorized third parties.
 
 Guidehouse does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Guidehouse and Guidehouse will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.
